### 2.2 Transforming Dataset


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
eldercare <- eldercare %>%
  select(fid, ADDRESSPOS) %>%
  mutate(capacity = 100)
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
hexagons <- hexagons %>%
  select(fid) %>%
  mutate(demand = 100)
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
ODMatrix_tidied <- ODMatrix %>%
  select(origin_id, destination_id, total_cost) %>%
  rename(from_id = origin_id,
         to_id = destination_id,
         dist = total_cost)
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
distmat <- ODMatrix %>%
  select(origin_id, destination_id, total_cost) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = destination_id, values_from = total_cost) %>%
  select(-origin_id)

distmat_km <- as.matrix(distmat/1000)
```
:::


## 3. Two-Step Floating Catchment Area

### 3.1 Creating dataframe


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
df_2sfca <- catchment_ratio(
  consumers = hexagons$demand,
  providers = eldercare$capacity,
  cost = distmat_km,
  max_cost = 5) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>% #transform list to dataframe
  rename("2SFCA" = ".") #change column name
```
:::


### 3.1 Mapping 2SFCA


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
mapex <- st_bbox(hexagons)
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
hexagon_2sfca <- bind_cols(hexagons, df_2sfca) #join() does not work without unique ID
tm_shape(hexagon_2sfca,
         bbox = mapex) + #bbox ensure that the map is fully extended, ensuring consistency
  tm_polygons(fill = "2SFCA", 
              fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
                style = "quantile",
                n = 10,
                values = "-brewer.blues")) + #use of - inverses the colour scheme
tm_shape(eldercare) +
  tm_dots(size = 0.3,
          fill = "red",
          col = "black") +
  tm_title("2SFCA Accessibility Measures") +
  tm_layout(frame = TRUE) +
  tm_compass(type="8star", size = 2) +
  tm_scalebar() +
  tm_grid(alpha = 0.2)
```

::: {.cell-output-display}

:::

## 4. Enhanced Two-Step Floating Catchment Area

This introduces weight for distance, thus reducing extreme values.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
step_weights <- list(c(5, .01), c(4, .05), c(3, .1),  c(2, .4), c(1, 1)) #providing weight to the distance, i.e., 1 for 1km, .4 for 2km, .01 for more than 5, where there is higher weight for closer proximity
df_e2sfca <- catchment_ratio(
  consumers = hexagons$demand,
  providers = eldercare$capacity,
  cost = distmat_km, #note the cost is different from df_2sfca
  max_cost = distmat_km,
  weight = step_weights) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>% #transform list to dataframe
  rename("e2SFCA" = ".") #change column name
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
hexagon_e2sfca <- bind_cols(hexagons, df_e2sfca) #join() does not work without unique ID
tm_shape(hexagon_e2sfca,
         bbox = mapex) + #bbox ensure that the map is fully extended, ensuring consistency
  tm_polygons(fill = "e2SFCA", 
              fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
                style = "quantile",
                n = 10,
                values = "-brewer.blues")) + #use of - inverses the colour scheme
tm_shape(eldercare) +
  tm_dots(size = 0.3,
          fill = "red",
          col = "black") +
  tm_title("Enhanced 2SFCA Accessibility Measures") +
  tm_layout(frame = TRUE) +
  tm_compass(type="8star", size = 2) +
  tm_scalebar() +
  tm_grid(alpha = 0.2)
```

## 5. Kernel Density (Gaussian) 2SFCA

This provides a smoother range.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
df_kd2sfca <- catchment_ratio(
  consumers = hexagons$demand,
  providers = eldercare$capacity,
  cost = distmat_km,
  weight = "gaussian") %>% #able to control unlike ac() 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rename("KD2SFCA" = ".") 
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
hexagon_kd2sfca <- bind_cols(hexagons, df_kd2sfca) 
tm_shape(hexagon_kd2sfca,
         bbox = mapex) + 
  tm_polygons(fill = "KD2SFCA", 
              fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
                style = "quantile",

tm_shape(eldercare) +

  tm_grid(alpha = 0.2)
```

## 6. 3-Step Floating Catchment Area

This method allows for the normalisation of weight, taking into account differing capacities of services.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
df_3sfca <- catchment_ratio(
  consumers = hexagons$demand,
  providers = eldercare$capacity,
  cost = distmat_km,
  step_weights,
  normalize_weight = TRUE) %>% #to normalise the weight 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rename("3SFCA" = ".") 
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
hexagon_3sfca <- bind_cols(hexagons, df_3sfca) 
tm_shape(hexagon_3sfca,
         bbox = mapex) + 
  tm_polygons(fill = "3SFCA", 
              fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
                style = "quantile",
                n = 10,
                values = "-brewer.blues")) + 
tm_shape(eldercare) +
  tm_dots(size = 0.3,
          fill = "red",
          col = "black") +
  tm_title("3SFCA Accessibility Measures") +
  tm_layout(frame = TRUE) +
  tm_compass(type="8star", size = 2) +
  tm_scalebar() +
  tm_grid(alpha = 0.2)
```
